privasi.poin1: Client-side image processing operations run entirely within your browser memory. Your images never leave your local device.
privasi.poin2: When server operations are used, images are transmitted temporarily for pure in-memory (RAM) processing and immediately deleted upon response completion without disk storage.
privasi.poin3: No permanent file storage, user accounts, image databases, or third-party tracking analytics exist.
privasi.poin4: Server access logs record only HTTP method, route, status code, duration, and error codes without ever logging original filenames or image content.

biner_manual.tujuan: Isolate foreground objects from background when the separation intensity threshold is precisely known.
biner_manual.penjelasanRumus: Y(x,y) is pixel luminance computed via ITU-R BT.601 standard, and T is the user threshold.

parameter.ambang: Luminance cutoff threshold (0..255). Pixels above this become white.
parameter.inversi: When enabled, inverts output logic (pixels below threshold become white).

biner_otsu.tujuan: Automatic binarization without manual threshold guesswork, highly effective on images with bimodal histograms.
biner_otsu.penjelasanRumus: Searches for optimal threshold T* maximizing inter-class variance σ_B²(T) over range [0..255].

parameter.inversi: Inverts the resulting binary image (dark foreground becomes white).

biner_adaptif.tujuan: Local binarization robust against non-uniform illumination and spatial lighting gradients.
biner_adaptif.rumus:
T(x,y) = Window_Mean(x,y) - C
g(x,y) = 255 if Y(x,y) > T(x,y), else 0
biner_adaptif.penjelasanRumus: Mean is computed in constant O(1) time using a 2D Summed-Area Table (Integral Image).

parameter.jendela: Odd-sized local spatial window dimension (e.g. 15 pixels).
parameter.konstanta: Constant subtrahend C to suppress background noise.
parameter.inversi: Invert binary polarity of segmentation result.

halus_mean.tujuan: Smooth image and reduce random high-frequency noise by averaging neighboring intensities.
halus_mean.penjelasanRumus: Computed in constant O(1) time independent of radius using Integral Images.

parameter.radius: Box window radius expanding from the center pixel.

halus_gaussian.tujuan: Smooth images naturally according to a normal distribution, avoiding harsh blocky artifacts.
halus_gaussian.penjelasanRumus: Executed as two 1D separable passes (horizontal then vertical) for O(2K) computational efficiency.

parameter.sigma: Standard deviation of Gaussian curve. Higher values yield broader blurring.

halus_median.tujuan: Cleanly remove salt-and-pepper impulse noise without destroying sharpness of object edges.
halus_median.penjelasanRumus: Ranks all neighborhood pixels and extracts the exact median rank element.

parameter.ukuran: Window dimension (3x3 with sorting network or 5x5 with insertion sort).

tajam_unsharp.tujuan: Enhance perceived sharpness by boosting contrast along edge transitions using a blurred difference mask.
tajam_unsharp.rumus:
Mask(x,y) = f(x,y) - Gaussian(x,y)
g(x,y) = f(x,y) + k · Mask(x,y)
tajam_unsharp.penjelasanRumus: High-frequency difference mask is multiplied by factor k and added back onto the original image.

parameter.sigma: Blur radius used to build the low-frequency unsharp mask.
parameter.ambang: Tonal threshold to prevent amplifying flat background noise.

tajam_kernel.tujuan: Instant spatial edge sharpening using discrete second-derivative Laplacian convolution kernels.

konvolusi_kernel.tujuan: Arbitrary linear spatial filtering for custom edge detection, embossing, sharpening, and blurring.
konvolusi_kernel.rumus: g(x,y) = clamp( round( (Σ Σ w(s,t) · f(x-s, y-t)) / Div + Bias ) )
konvolusi_kernel.penjelasanRumus: True convolution rotates the kernel by 180° (f(x-s, y-t)), distinct from cross-correlation f(x+s, y+t).

parameter.matriks: Matrix containing spatial neighborhood weighting coefficients.
parameter.pembagi: Divisor factor normalizing sum of weights to preserve overall brightness.

tepi_sobel.tujuan: Detect object contour edges using weighted differential spatial gradients on X and Y axes.
tepi_sobel.penjelasanRumus: Center weight factor of 2 provides smoothing that resists high-frequency noise spikes.

parameter.arah: Gradient direction (horizontal Gx, vertical Gy, or combined magnitude).
parameter.inversi: Outputs dark pencil sketch edges on clean white background.

tepi_prewitt.tujuan: Gradient edge detection using orthogonal masks with uniform weights across neighboring pixels.
tepi_prewitt.penjelasanRumus: Measures regular gradient transitions with linear response to intensity variance.

tepi_roberts.tujuan: High-speed edge discontinuity detection using simple 2×2 diagonal pixel differences.
tepi_roberts.rumus:
Gx = f(x,y) - f(x+1, y+1)
Gy = f(x+1, y) - f(x, y+1)
|G| = √(Gx² + Gy²)
tepi_roberts.penjelasanRumus: Extremely responsive to fine diagonal edges due to minimal 2×2 window span.

parameter.inversi: Inverts output to dark sketch contours.

tepi_laplacian.tujuan: Isotropic (rotation-invariant) second-derivative edge detector based on ∇²f.
tepi_laplacian.penjelasanRumus: Yields zero response in flat uniform regions and positive/negative zero-crossing peaks at edges.
